SourceTopic.InnerMotivation: The saloon's ice cream and milk stocks are nearly empty before the weekend crowd arrives.
SourceTopic.PublicOpinion: Gus prides himself on keeping the Stardrop Saloon fully stocked for every celebration.

TargetTopic.InnerMotivation: Pierre wants his general-store dairy displayed prominently at the saloon to boost his own sales.
TargetTopic.PublicOpinion: Pierre is always looking for a reason to deliver goods across town and chat with regulars.

SourceTopic.InnerMotivation: One of the store display shelves cracked under the weight of unsold seeds and needs a carpenter before it collapses.

TargetTopic.InnerMotivation: Robin enjoys the excuse to take a short break from roofing jobs and do a tidy carpentry repair.

SourceTopic.InnerMotivation: Willy's spare anchor is rusted to the point where it might snap off during the next storm.
